# Nextra

Docs built with Nextra (`nextra`, `nextra-theme-docs`) on Next.js. Reference: https://nextra.site/docs/file-conventions/meta-file and https://nextra.site/docs/guide/syntax-highlighting.

## Detect

- `package.json` has `nextra` and `nextra-theme-docs` (or `nextra-theme-blog`, which is a blog, not docs).
- `next.config.*` wraps the config with `nextra({...})`.
- `_meta.{js,jsx,ts,tsx}` files (`_meta.json` in old sites, `_meta.global.*` for a single-file tree).
- Live site: `/_next/` assets and `nextra-` CSS classes.

Then pick the generation. Config and content live in different places:

| Signal                                                                   | Generation   |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------ |
| `theme.config.{js,jsx,ts,tsx}` + content in `pages/`                     | Pages Router |
| `<Layout>` from `nextra-theme-docs` in `app/layout.*`, no `theme.config` | App Router   |

## Get the source

### From the repo

- Pages Router: every `.md`/`.mdx` under `pages/` (or `src/pages/`) is a page.
- App Router: `content/` (or `src/content/`) served through `app/[[...mdxPath]]/page.jsx`, and/or `app/**/page.mdx`. Both can coexist; collect both.
- Read `next.config.*` (`basePath`, `contentDirBasePath`, `i18n`, `latex`, `redirects()`), the theme config (`theme.config.*` or the `app/layout.*` props), and `mdx-components.*` for components used without imports.
- i18n: read `i18n.locales` in `next.config`, then find how files are split per locale (locale-suffixed files such as `index.en.mdx`, or one folder per locale). Each locale has its own `_meta` files.

### From an export

None; the site is built from the repo.

### From the live site

No raw-markdown endpoint. Mirror the rendered `<article>` per page and read the sidebar from the HTML.

## Config → docs.json

Pages Router keys are in `theme.config.*`; App Router keys are props on `<Layout>`, `<Navbar>`, `<Footer>`, `<Banner>` in `app/layout.*`.

| Nextra                                              | docs.json                                                                 |
| --------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `logo` / `<Navbar logo>` (JSX)                      | `name` from the text, `logo` from the image                               |
| `project.link` / `<Navbar projectLink>`             | `navbar.links` entry with `type: "github"` (if GitHub)                    |
| `chat.link` / `<Navbar chatLink>`                   | `navbar.links` entry (`type: "discord"` if Discord)                       |
| `banner.content`, `banner.dismissible` / `<Banner>` | `banner.content`, `banner.dismissible`                                    |
| `footer` / `<Footer>` children                      | `footer.links` / `footer.socials` if it holds links; else drop and report |
| `head` / `<Head>`                                   | `seo.metatags` for static tags; dynamic logic drop and report             |
| `darkMode`, `nextThemes.defaultTheme`               | `appearance`                                                              |
| `primaryHue`, `primarySaturation`                   | `colors.primary` (take the hex from the rendered CSS)                     |
| `lastUpdated`                                       | `metadata.timestamp`                                                      |
| `i18n` (theme) + `i18n` (`next.config`)             | `navigation.languages` if languages are migrated, else report             |
| `latex: true` (`next.config`)                       | none; math renders natively                                               |
| `docsRepositoryBase`, `editLink`, `feedback`        | drop and report                                                           |
| `search`, `sidebar.*`, `toc.*`, `navigation`        | drop and report                                                           |
| `basePath`, `contentDirBasePath`, `trailingSlash`   | none; affect URLs, see below                                              |

## Navigation

Each folder's `_meta` sets order and labels for its own children. A folder's label lives in the parent `_meta`, under the folder's key.

| `_meta` entry                                             | Mintlify                                                                        |
| --------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| key order                                                 | `pages` order; unlisted files follow alphabetically (`index` first if unlisted) |
| `key: 'Label'` or `{ title }` on a page                   | `sidebarTitle` when it differs from the page H1                                 |
| `key: 'Label'` on a folder                                | `group` label for that folder                                                   |
| JSX title                                                 | its text                                                                        |
| root `type: 'page'` (folder)                              | `navigation.tabs` entry `{ tab: title, groups }`                                |
| root `type: 'page'` with `href`                           | tab with `href`                                                                 |
| `type: 'menu'` + `items` with `href`                      | tab with `menu: [{ item, href }]`                                               |
| `type: 'separator'` with `title`                          | close the current group; following items form group `title`                     |
| `type: 'separator'` without `title`                       | drop                                                                            |
| `display: 'hidden'`                                       | leave out of navigation (still served)                                          |
| `display: 'children'`                                     | reproduce the rendered sidebar; report                                          |
| `{ title, href }` sidebar link                            | top level: `navigation.global.anchors`; nested: drop and report                 |
| `theme: { layout: 'full' }`                               | page frontmatter `mode: "wide"`; report                                         |
| other `theme` keys (`sidebar`, `toc`, `typesetting`, ...) | drop and report                                                                 |
| `'*': {...}`                                              | apply to every sibling, then drop                                               |
| `_meta.global.*`                                          | same rules; folder entries carry children in `items`                            |
| folder `index.mdx`, or a page with `asIndexPage: true`    | group `root`                                                                    |

With the default `sidebar.defaultMenuCollapseLevel` (2), top-level folders start open; if they become nested groups, set `expanded: true`.

Root `type: 'page'` entries that point at a single page (`index`, `about`) become tabs with that page, or `navbar.links` if the source shows them as utility links.

## Content conversion

| Nextra                                                                       | Mintlify                                                                       |
| ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `<Callout>` / `type="default"`                                               | `<Tip>`                                                                        |
| `type="info"`                                                                | `<Note>`                                                                       |
| `type="warning"`                                                             | `<Warning>`                                                                    |
| `type="error"`                                                               | `<Danger>`                                                                     |
| `type="important"`                                                           | `<Info>`                                                                       |
| `type={null}`                                                                | plain paragraph                                                                |
| Callout `emoji`                                                              | drop, or `<Callout icon>` if the emoji carries meaning                         |
| `> [!NOTE]` etc. (rendered as callouts)                                      | (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, GitHub alerts)                             |
| `<Tabs items={[...]}>` + `<Tabs.Tab>` / `<Tab>`                              | `<Tabs>` + `<Tab title={items[i]}>`                                            |
| `<Tabs defaultIndex>`; `storageKey`                                          | `defaultTabIndex`; drop                                                        |
| `<Cards num={n}>` + `<Cards.Card>` / `<Card icon title href arrow>`          | `<Columns cols={n}>` + `<Card title href arrow>`; JSX icon → icon name or drop |
| `<Steps>` wrapping `##`-`######` headings                                    | `<Steps>`; each heading and its content → `<Step title="...">`                 |
| `<FileTree>` / `<FileTree.Folder name defaultOpen>` / `<FileTree.File name>` | `<Tree>` / `<Tree.Folder>` / `<Tree.File>` (not Mintlify's `<FileTree>`)       |
| `<Table>`                                                                    | markdown table                                                                 |
| `## Heading [#custom-id]`                                                    | `## Heading {#custom-id}`                                                      |
| ` ```mermaid `                                                               | keep                                                                           |
| ` ```math ` fence                                                            | `$$ ... $$` block                                                              |
| inline code with `{:lang}` suffix (`` `let x{:js}` ``)                       | strip the suffix                                                               |

Code fence meta:

| Nextra                | Mintlify                                                  |
| --------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| `filename="x.js"`     | `title="x.js"`                                            |
| `{1,4-5}`             | `highlight={1,4-5}`                                       |
| `showLineNumbers`     | `lines`                                                   |
| `copy`                | drop                                                      |
| `copy=false`          | `nocopy`                                                  |
| `/word/`, `/word/1-3` | drop; report                                              |
| `npm2yarn`            | (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Package-manager tabs) |

Imports: remove `nextra/components`, `nextra-theme-docs`, `nextra/icons`, `next/link` and `next/image` after converting usages (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Components).

Frontmatter: keep `title`, `sidebarTitle`; drop `asIndexPage` after using it for navigation. Pages often have no frontmatter: the title is the body H1.

## Assets

`public/` is served from the site root: `public/demo.png` → `/demo.png` (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Images and files). Rewrite relative static images such as `![](../public/demo.png)` and imported images to that root path. `<Image src>` from `nextra/components` and `<ImageZoom src>` become a markdown image with the same `src` and `alt`.

## URLs and redirects

- Pages Router: `pages/a/b.mdx` → `/a/b`; `index` → its folder.
- App Router content dir: `content/a/b.mdx` → `<contentDirBasePath>/a/b`. App files: `app/a/b/page.mdx` → `/a/b`; `(group)` folders add no segment.
- `basePath` in `next.config` prefixes every URL. Locales prefix the path (`/<locale>/...`). `trailingSlash: true` adds a slash.

Port `async redirects()` from `next.config` and add a base path redirect if the Mintlify site drops `basePath` or `contentDirBasePath` (`mint migrate --topic navigation`, Redirects). Expand entries using `has`/`missing` or `basePath: false` to exact paths, or report them.

## Known gaps

Report these:

- `<Bleed>`, `<Playground>`, `<Banner>` outside the layout, and `nextra-theme-blog` pages.
- Per-page `theme` switches, `display: 'children'`, nested sidebar links, untitled separators.
- `/word/` substring highlighting and inline `{:lang}` highlighting.
- MathJax renderer and custom `latex` macros.
- Edit link, feedback link, dynamic `head` logic, and custom 404 pages.
